watches.name: AVL III Titanium
watches.description: A camera lens, reimagined for the wrist. AVL III Titanium is crafted in Grade 2 titanium with a 46.5 mm case, fish-eye sapphire crystal, 10 ATM water resistance, Japanese Nemoto luminous details and a Miyota open-heart automatic movement. Made in Japan and individually numbered. A lens you can wear. AVL III Titanium distills the spirit of a classic DSLR prime into a daily companion—light on the wrist yet heavy with detail. The 46 mm Grade 2 titanium case frames a dial that echoes a fast lens: dual-level “elements,” a circular aperture window that reveals the heart of the movement, and a subtle red ring—an insider nod to Japan’s pro-grade lenses. Under the double-curved crystal, Japanese Nemoto luminous draws an elegant figure-eight around the lens forms, glowing like a midnight city ring road when the lights go down. Titanium changes everything. Compared with steel, Grade 2 titanium brings strength-to-weight efficiency, a warmer sheen, and all-day comfort. Paired with a full Grade 2 titanium bracelet (quick-release), the watch still weighs just 154 g , balancing presence with wearability. The sculpted case flanks are clean and purposeful; the polished bezel catches light like glass on a camera body; the caseback is fully exhibition—because every mechanical story deserves a window. Built for the real world, AVL III Titanium is Made in Japan and sealed to 10 ATM for daily confidence—from rain to city runs. The 16 mm profile sits low and modern; a precise knurled crown brings that reassuring “click” of a lens mount. Turn the wrist and the luminous geometry comes alive: hour markers and hands burn in cool green while the lens tracks form a continuous halo, making instant legibility part of the design language, not an afterthought. Design is only half the story; usability is the rest. The dial’s clean minute track, offset “focus scale” graphic, and red index pip make quick reads intuitive. Brushing and polishing alternate across the titanium surfaces to emphasize the camera-tool aesthetic. Each watch carries an individual serial number , engraved to mark its place in the TACS archive. This is not just another camera-inspired watch—it is the next lightweight chapter of the Lens series, crafted with Japanese restraint and the quiet confidence of titanium. If you know the feeling of twisting a perfectly damped focus ring, you’ll understand AVL III Titanium. It’s the same satisfaction—translated for the wrist.

watches.name: ATL Lite X Robotoys
watches.description: 15th Anniversary, 399 sets only. ATL Lite’s twin-lens depth meets a numbered Black Robotoy stand. 8N24 automatic , K1 domed crystal , Swiss luminous , 10 ATM , Made in Japan , 87 g . A wearable design icon—plus a display piece that steals the scene. Meet the ATL Lite X Robotoys – Black Limited (399 sets worldwide) , created to celebrate TACS’ 15th Anniversary. It merges our beloved twin-lens design with a handcrafted Robotoy display stand —both sharing the same serial number. The watch keeps the ATL Lite DNA: open-heart depth with twin “lens” windows, feather-light comfort at 87 g , and everyday toughness with 10 ATM water resistance. Driven by the reliable 8N24 automatic movement , ATL Lite X Robotoys reveals the heartbeat of time through two miniature glass elements on the dial and a full exhibition caseback. A K1 domed crystal amplifies the optical layers, while upgraded Swiss luminous accents trace the twin-lens silhouette for vivid nighttime legibility. Built from 316L stainless steel with a quick-fit rubber strap , it’s crafted in Japan to be worn daily and admired forever. Each set includes a Black Robotoy stand —fully poseable, industrial-art inspired, and numbered to match your watch. Park it on your desk, pose it for photos, or use it as the most conversation-starting watch holder you’ll ever own. Limited, collectible, and unapologetically fun.

specsRaw.More than a stand: the articulated hands can grip small items (pen, card, note) and the broad feet keep the figure stable, so it doubles as a useful desk companion.

watches.name: ATL Lite
watches.description: A lightweight reimagining of the iconic twin-lens ATL, hand-assembled in Japan with 11 parts. Perfectly proportioned, mechanically soulful, and made for everyday wear. Redefining Lightweight, Timeless Craftsmanship The ATL Lite takes everything you love about the iconic ATL series—its photography-inspired aesthetics, mechanical soul, and Japanese craftsmanship—and refines it into a lighter, sleeker silhouette. Inspired by the twin-lens reflex cameras of the 1920s, this timepiece features a multi-layered dial assembled from 11 handcrafted parts. Designed for everyday adventures, it weighs just 87g, offering all-day comfort without sacrificing bold character. With a transparent caseback, open-heart dial, and anti-reflective curved K1 glass, the ATL Lite invites you to view time from a new lens—compact, mechanical, and full of soul.

watches.name: AM
watches.description: A nostalgic twist of retro mechanics and scooter culture, the Automatic Motorscooter revs up your wrist with a unique engine-inspired design. Available in Rosso Red and Verde Green, both ride-ready. Inspired by the charm of vintage scooters, the Automatic Motorscooter merges mechanical precision with playful, kinetic aesthetics. From the curved Vespa-like case to the visible engine gears on the dial, this timepiece is all about freedom, energy, and movement. Key design cues include: A kickstart lever at 3 o’clock — yes, it’s the crown. A fuel cock protector and gas cap crown . A shock absorber-style lug at 10 o’clock. Double-dome sapphire glass that delivers bold distortion and clarity. A see-through dial mimicking an exposed engine. Whether you choose the Verde (Teal Green) or Rosso (Racing Red) , each watch is equipped with a high-performance rubber strap from Hirsch and a 22-jewel automatic movement. Made in Japan, this model is not just a fashion piece — it’s a machine in motion. The Automatic Motorscooter is not just an accessory — it’s a wearable tribute to the charm of 1960s and 70s urban exploration. Its case lines mirror the body curves of vintage scooters, while its rubber strap recalls scooter tires gripping the pavement. Built to celebrate the synergy between mechanics and motion, this is a piece for collectors, designers, and riders at heart.

watches.name: AC
watches.description: A retro-styled automatic watch inspired by cassette players. Featuring a 24-jewel Japanese movement, cassette-style dial, and K1 crystal. A time machine for music lovers. Automatic Cassette – Back to the 80s, Reimagined on Your Wrist Rewind time with the Automatic Cassette , a mechanical wristwatch that pays homage to the golden age of analog sound. Inspired by retro cassette players from the 80s, this design fuses nostalgic aesthetics with Japanese craftsmanship. From the “Play,” “Stop,” and “Replay” icons to the volume-knob crown and layered sound-wave textures, every detail is a tribute to vintage music gear. The dial features a cassette window-style layout that reveals the open-heart mechanical movement , creating the illusion of motion behind the music. At its core beats a Made in Japan 24-jewel automatic movement , delivering reliable performance and smooth sweep. The case is fitted with a K1 hardened mineral glass (non-sapphire) that is scratch-resistant and anti-reflective. With 10ATM water resistance , Japanese Nemoto luminous hands , and a solid 316L stainless steel case, the Automatic Cassette is built to groove through daily wear.

watches.name: Sooda
watches.description: Enjoy every sunny day – TACS SOODA is a solar-powered wristwatch blending nature-inspired design with sustainable tech. With 90 days of power reserve, a vegan leather strap, and panda-inspired sub-dials, it’s a fresh take on eco-conscious horology. Meet SOODA – the first-ever solar-powered timepiece by TACS, where sustainability meets playful sophistication. Inspired by nature and designed with intention, SOODA fuses Japanese craftsmanship with a lighthearted panda-inspired dial layout that’s as functional as it is adorable. This 38mm unisex watch features dual solar panels cleverly styled as “eyes” – one showing the battery indicator and the other a 24-hour dial. The 6 o’clock date window adds further daily utility, all while the solar movement offers an impressive 90-day power reserve. Crafted with 316L stainless steel and fitted with an Italian vegan leather strap certified by “Pelle Conciata al Vegetale”, SOODA balances daily durability with a commitment to conscious living. Its playful layout hides a serious purpose: reminding wearers that time is powered by the sun – nature’s original source of energy. Whether you choose the soft beige or classic espresso strap, SOODA speaks to those who value clean aesthetics and earth-friendly design.

watches.name: Architecture
watches.description: A Modular Timepiece Like No Other – Inspired by the Nakagin Capsule Tower, Architecture blends modular design and mechanical precision into a minimalist masterpiece. Crafted in Japan with an open-heart dial, 10ATM water resistance, and concrete-textured finish — it’s more than a watch. It’s a blueprint on your wrist. Step into the future with Architecture — a mechanical wristwatch inspired by Tokyo’s legendary Nakagin Capsule Tower. Paying tribute to the Japanese Metabolism architecture movement , this model embraces modularity, innovation, and purposeful design. At the heart of this timepiece is a concrete-textured open-heart dial , framed by a clean 41mm case crafted from surgical-grade 316L stainless steel. With a dome-shaped K1 glass and an exhibition case back, you’ll see both beauty and mechanics from every angle. Between 6–7 o’clock sits an open-heart window, revealing the movement’s clutch wheel in motion — a nod to the interconnected capsule units in Metabolist architecture. Another small aperture near 3 o’clock adds depth, texture, and a sense of rhythm to the dial. Powered by a Made in Japan Miyota 82S0 movement , the Architecture combines 21 jewels with smooth mechanical performance. The 10ATM water resistance, Super-LumiNova detailing, and hypoallergenic materials make this watch not just a statement — but a durable everyday companion. Choose from 3 distinct tones: TS2301A Concrete : Urban industrial grey, echoing modern minimalism. TS2301B Raspberry : A soft pink tone — delicate, modern, and playful. TS2301C Limestone : A creamy neutral hue for understated elegance. Each watch features a premium quick-release Italian leather strap that adjusts between 130mm to 195mm, perfect for all-day wear. Whether you’re an architecture lover, a design nerd, or someone who values thoughtful craftsmanship, Architecture is a wearable tribute to structural imagination.

specsRaw.TS2301A Concrete: Urban industrial grey, echoing modern minimalism.
specsRaw.TS2301B Raspberry: A soft pink tone — delicate, modern, and playful.
specsRaw.TS2301C Limestone: A creamy neutral hue for understated elegance.

watches.name: Time Ruler
watches.description: The technicolor of elapsed time – A nostalgic tribute to the way we first learned to tell time. The Time Ruler features an hour + second hand display with a “time ruler” minute sub-track and open-heart window. Finished with Italian leather and powered by a Japanese Miyota movement. Measure Time with Meaning TACS introduces the Time Ruler , a creative reimagining of how we perceive the passage of time. Inspired by the simplicity of school-day elapsed time charts, this watch distills a nostalgic yet functional idea into a bold, modern timepiece. It’s not just a watch — it’s a playful memory of how we first learned to measure life in minutes and seconds. A Minimalist Time Tunnel Instead of three hands, the Time Ruler features just an hour hand and a sweeping second hand , set against a sandblasted dome dial that creates soft gradients under light. What sets it apart? A quirky “elapsed time ruler” sub-track at 9 o’clock replaces the traditional minute hand. This unique dial layout transforms everyday time-reading into a visual and tactile experience. Open Your View on Time At 6 o’clock, the mini open-heart aperture offers a glimpse into the beating heart of the watch — the Japanese Miyota 82S0 automatic movement , known for its reliability and precision. Flip it over and you’ll find a transparent case back , offering even more mechanical depth. Colors with Character Choose from four striking dial options that feel playful yet mature: Chalk White with black strap Jasper Orange with caramel strap Aqua Mint with cocoa brown strap Rose Pink with dusty lavender strap Each dial is paired with a high-quality Italian vegetable-tanned leather strap , soft to the touch and built to age beautifully with time. The quick-release mechanism makes swapping easy to suit your outfit or mood. Built to Wear, Made to Last Crafted from 316L stainless steel , the 38mm case sits at 13mm thick — a confident presence without being bulky. Water resistance is rated at 5ATM , and the strap features a waterproof lining for daily comfort.

watches.name: Ice Bubble
watches.description: Playful twist for your wrist – A whimsical second-hand floats like a frozen droplet in this compact 33mm Ice Bubble — where minimalism meets movement. Introducing the Ice Bubble — a minimalist timepiece that captures the beauty of frozen time. As the evolved version of our popular Icicle , this petite 33mm model refines the aesthetic further with a playful twist: a bubble-shaped small second hand nestled at the 5 o’clock position, spinning like a droplet caught in a crystal-clear moment. The Ice Bubble uses MIYOTA small second movement , protected by a shiny polished case made from durable 316L stainless steel . The sandblasted dial creates a gentle contrast with the reflective Ice Cube-effect glass , a signature TACS element that plays with light from every angle. The slim 11.5mm thickness and feather-light 30g weight make it a comfortable daily accessory for those who appreciate elegance without overstatement. Whether you’re at brunch, in the gallery, or dressing up for the night — Ice Bubble effortlessly blends sophistication with artistic subtlety.

specsRaw.Color: Coconut White -A, Milk White -B, Chestnut Brown -C

watches.name: Turn Table
watches.description: A music-inspired modern affair – A minimalist bangle watch inspired by music, crafted with Japanese precision. 3 timeless finishes—Silver, Rose Gold, and Gold. A celebration of simplicity and rhythm, the TACS Turn Table is a modern reinterpretation of vintage music culture fused into a jewellery-inspired timepiece. Designed in Japan, this bangle watch captures the essence of a turntable through a sleek, minimal silhouette that complements any outfit. The clean dial, stripped of hour markers, offers a subtle nod to the analog world of records. Powered by a Miyota slim movement , this 27mm stainless steel watch is lightweight yet refined—ideal for women who appreciate form with function. Whether worn solo or stacked with accessories, Turn Table is a statement of individuality.

watches.name: Pearl
watches.description: A petite bracelet timepiece for everyday – A feminine, ultra-slim bracelet watch with a domed glass and genuine mother-of-pearl dial. Minimal, elegant, and effortlessly versatile. Meet Pearl — a petite bracelet-like timepiece that blends minimalist elegance with everyday versatility. Inspired by the natural beauty of the sea’s only living gemstone, Pearl brings a delicate statement to your wrist with its ultra-slim case and soft-toned leather strap. Designed for the refined, modern woman, Pearl embraces Japanese minimalism and organic charm in one graceful form. Available in three timeless finishes — Silver (Oyster White) , Rose Gold (Light Sage) , and Gold (Nori Green) — each version features a domed glass, minimalist mother-of-pearl dial, and a tiny pearl-like disc at 12 o’clock. Powered by Swiss Ronda quartz movement and crafted with premium 316L stainless steel, this compact yet expressive piece offers both beauty and reliability in a wearable 10g form. Whether paired with gold earrings, layered bracelets, or left to shine on its own, Pearl is the perfect complement to your personal style — a watch that whispers elegance and speaks volumes.

specsRaw.Color: Oyster White -A, Rose Gold -B, Nori Green -C

watches.name: Sunrise Sunset
watches.description: A Timepiece for Slower Living – A 24-hour watch inspired by the slow living movement. Featuring a rotating dial that mimics sunrise and sunset, Swiss quartz movement, and minimalist Japanese design. Live by the Light — Sunrise Sunset by TACS In a world of rapid pings, scrolling feeds, and digital urgency, Sunrise Sunset is a 24-hour timepiece that invites you to slow down and savor the now. Powered by Swiss Ronda 505.24H quartz movement, this minimalist watch captures the poetic rhythm of day and night through a rotating dial inspired by celestial motion. Instead of the traditional hour and minute hands, Sunrise Sunset features a cutout rotating disc that mimics the sun’s arc. As the day progresses, the top layer of the dial slowly shifts, revealing hour markers in sequence from the aluminum disc below — a symbolic gesture of being present in the moment. At dusk, the watch enters “dark mode,” as the lower half of the hour disc transitions into a sandblasted gradient that resembles twilight sky. Whether in the calm of morning or the quiet of evening, Sunrise Sunset doesn’t just tell time — it reflects your time. Designed with clean Japanese aesthetics and built with refined materials, this timepiece offers both form and function. The 40mm case is crafted from satin-finished 316L stainless steel. The black or teal dial variants are matched with premium waterproof Italian leather straps that feature quick-release spring bars for fast styling swaps. From mindfulness seekers to design lovers, Sunrise Sunset is made for anyone who appreciates the poetic beauty of slowing down — one revolution at a time.

watches.name: MPA
watches.description: Show your best side – Half-mask, full character — the MPA redefines timekeeping through a dramatic dual-tone dial and visible automatic movement. Bold. Conceptual. Intriguing. The MPA (Mask Player Automatic) breaks away from traditional watch design with a statement that challenges time itself. This watch divides the dial into a dramatic two-tone mask, revealing the automatic movement beneath through an open-heart aperture. Its asymmetric layout and hidden indices invite curiosity, while its creative split dial keeps the time readable yet playfully abstract. Crafted for those who appreciate both fine mechanics and bold visual storytelling, the MPA is a wearable conversation piece that dares to be different.

specsRaw.Color: Phantom Black -A, Ash Blue -B, Pyrite Gold -C

watches.name: ATL Rollei
watches.description: A twin-lens camera–inspired automatic watch. Made in Japan. Limited to 500 pieces. The ATL Rollei watch is a tribute to the legendary twin-lens Rolleiflex camera, reimagined as a mechanical timepiece. Designed for those who appreciate both vintage photography and precise engineering, this watch merges function, nostalgia, and Japanese craftsmanship in a striking form. Inspired by the iconic Rolleiflex twin-lens camera, the ATL Rollei is a Japanese-made automatic watch that brings timeless photographic aesthetics to your wrist. Every detail — from the dial structure to the engraved founder names of Paul Franke and Reinhold Heidecke — celebrates the craftsmanship behind vintage photography. The watch features upgraded DLC coating for durability, a soft leather strap sourced from Mexico, and a fully see-through case back that exposes its mechanical movement. A subtle yet striking tribute to the analog era, the ATL Rollei watch is more than a timepiece — it’s a collector’s lens on time. With only 500 pieces available worldwide, each comes in a special box resembling a classic camera case, enhancing the unboxing experience. This is your chance to own a wearable tribute to photography and precision. While many watches draw inspiration from classic design, the ATL Rollei watch goes a step further by embodying the spirit of the twin-lens era. Every component is considered — from the multi-layered dial construction to the crown detailing. Even the unboxing experience is memorable, with packaging that resembles a vintage leather camera case. Whether you’re a watch enthusiast, a photography lover, or simply someone who values thoughtful design, the ATL Rollei watch is crafted to speak your language. This limited-edition piece invites you to capture time — not just measure it. As a fusion of horology and photography, the ATL Rollei watch captures the beauty of vintage engineering. Limited, expressive, and timeless — this watch is for those who view time as art.

watches.name: ATL Gold X Robotoys
watches.description: A golden mechanical collectible — the ATL Gold X Robotoys pairs a Japan-made, twin-lens inspired watch with a matching handmade Robotoy. Limited to 150 sets worldwide. Step into a world where mechanics meet artistry. The ATL Gold X Robotoys is a radiant fusion of horology and imagination — a golden tribute to craftsmanship and creativity. Limited to just 150 pieces worldwide , this collector’s set pairs the iconic ATL Gold camera-inspired watch with a matching, fully poseable handmade robot stand — each engraved with a synchronized serial number. Crafted in Japan, the ATL Gold is built with 19 distinct components and finished with DLC coating for lasting brilliance. The two golden “twin lenses” on the dial echo the legendary Rolleiflex camera, framed by concentric detailing and glimmering highlights. The paired Robotoy isn’t just a stand — it’s a mechanical companion, adding movement, story, and soul to your timepiece. Whether you’re a connoisseur, a creative mind, or a nostalgic dreamer, this is more than a watch. It’s a statement of mechanical art in motion.

watches.name: ATL – Boxset
watches.description: A handcrafted collector’s edition for photography lovers and watch enthusiasts alike. The ATL Boxset includes twin straps, lens cap, adjustment tool, and a Japan-made twin-lens inspired timepiece — all housed in an elegant wooden box. Where Mechanics Meet Memories Inspired by the iconic twin-lens camera, the ATL Boxset is a true collector’s dream. This special edition includes both leather and metal straps, housed in a beautiful handcrafted wooden box, along with a lens cap, adjustment tool, and warranty card. The watch features a twin-lens camera dial with sapphire crystal, precision Japan automatic movement with 21 jewels, and a layered dial structure echoing the mechanical charm of classic photography. Each detail has been thoughtfully designed to recreate the nostalgic soul of analog craftsmanship, including engraved aperture scales, lens-style bezel, and the iconic “viewfinder” twin-circle layout. With 19 parts crafted in Japan and a mix of brushed and polished finishing, it’s a statement piece both technically and emotionally. Perfect for those who treasure timeless aesthetics and want more than just a watch — they want a story on the wrist. Immerse yourself in the mechanical elegance of the ATL Boxset – a masterfully curated collector’s edition from TACS. Inspired by the iconic twin-lens cameras of the golden analog era, this timepiece transforms timekeeping into an artistic ritual. The ATL Boxset includes not only the ATL 2002A (Silver) or 2002B (Gold) watch, but also a hand-assembled wooden box, matching metal and leather straps, a lens cap, a strap adjustment tool, and a warranty card — an all-inclusive experience designed for those who seek precision and poise in every detail. Crafted in Japan with over 19 uniquely engineered parts, the ATL Boxset celebrates craftsmanship at its purest. Each watch houses a sapphire crystal with anti-reflection coating, delivering a lens-like viewing experience. Through the open-heart twin-lens dial, the inner movement echoes like a vintage camera shutter — a nostalgic nod to the passion for both photography and mechanical artistry. From the satin-brushed metal bracelet to the stitched leather strap, each material in the set is chosen with care, balancing form and function. This boxset is not only a watch — it’s a personal toolkit for self-expression.

watches.name: Automatic Twin Lens – Antique Limited Edition
watches.description: 500-piece limited edition with antique-finished 316L case, distressed vintage strap, and Japan automatic movement. A nostalgic nod to time, crafted for collectors. Step into the past, powered by the present. The ATL Antique limited edition brings timeless craftsmanship into the now. With only 500 pieces available globally, this timepiece is not just a watch—it’s a collector’s story. Its 316L stainless steel case and matching buckle are aged with a weathered antique finish, giving each piece its own soul. Complemented by a hand-treated vintage leather strap, this model wears like a relic from another era—yet it houses a Japan-made automatic movement with 21 jewels at its core. Inspired by the twin-lens camera, the ATL Antique captures your every second through layers of retro texture and mechanical beauty. Its luminous detailing glows softly in the dark, while the case reveals aged textures like an old camera passed down generations. It’s not trying to be vintage. It is vintage—reborn.

watches.name: ATL
watches.description: An unique designed watch inspired by the iconic vintage twins lens reflex camera Capture Time, Frame Every Moment The ATL 2002A (silver) and 2002B (gold) editions bring TACS’ most iconic design into daily wear with Japanese finesse and quiet strength. Inspired by the twin-lens reflex cameras of the mid-20th century, the ATL is more than a timepiece — it’s a wearable homage to storytelling, structure, and soul. Each watch is hand-assembled in Japan with 19 individual parts , carefully layered to recreate the lens-like depth that defines the ATL experience. The twin domes of the dial, the tactile rotating bezel, the contrast textures — all are drawn from photography’s golden age, translated into a form that wraps gently around the wrist. Protected by a domed sapphire crystal , powered by a skeletonized Miyota 8N24 automatic movement , and anchored with a stitched leather strap, the ATL wears bold but never loud — making it the perfect companion for those who observe deeply, move gently, and live curiously. The ATL doesn’t ask for attention — it earns it. With every subtle layer and measured detail, it brings Japanese precision into your daily rhythm. This is a timepiece made not to impress, but to express. Learn more about Miyota 8N24 movement — a trusted Japanese movement powering ATL. For a square-case variation, explore the AVL II , TACS’ other tribute to camera form.

watches.name: Clock Watch
watches.description: Wall clock inspiration meets modern minimalism. The Clock brings bold design and effortless readability to your wrist with its iconic simplicity and reliable Japanese quartz movement. Time, Uncomplicated. The Clock captures the purest essence of time—bold, minimal, and straightforward. With its clean dial and contrasting red or luminous numerals, this 41mm timepiece is an homage to the everyday wall clock, reimagined for your wrist. A reliable Citizen Miyota quartz movement ensures precision, while the lightweight 34g stainless steel case and genuine leather strap offer all-day comfort. Whether you choose the sharp monochrome White-B, the soft vintage Beige-A, or the playful retro Black-C with glow-in-the-dark numerals, Clock brings a nostalgic charm with modern wearability. Perfect for those who believe that simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

watches.name: AVL II Two Tone X Robotoys
watches.description: Limited to 150 sets worldwide, the AVL II Two Tone X Robotoys combines a camera-inspired automatic watch with a handmade, matching-number Robotoy stand — a mechanical duo that reimagines time with style and imagination. Step into the world of mechanical art with the AVL II Two Tone X Robotoys — a rare fusion of horology and imagination. Limited to just 150 sets globally, this collaborative edition is where precision meets play. The AVL II watch, inspired by vintage single-lens reflex cameras, boasts a rotating bezel mimicking the tactile twist of a camera focus ring. Encased in stainless steel with an eye-catching two-tone metal band (silver and black), this 47mm watch houses a Japanese automatic movement and domed sapphire lens with a fish-eye effect. But it doesn’t stop there — every timepiece comes with a hand-assembled, poseable Robotoy that doubles as a creative display stand. Matching serial numbers across both the watch and the robot make each set truly one of a kind. Whether you’re a collector, a photographer, or a fan of craftsmanship, this set transforms how you perceive time.

specsRaw.Color: AVL II Two Tone X Robotoys

watches.name: AVL II Bronze X Robotoys Limited Boxset
watches.description: Bronze edition of the AVL II meets Robotoys in this limited-edition 150-piece boxset—featuring oxidized bronze finishing, handmade collectible Robotoy, and vintage camera-inspired design. Inspired by the soul of vintage cameras and the warm glow of bronze, the AVL II Bronze X Robotoys Limited Boxset is more than a watch—it’s a storytelling machine on your wrist. This exclusive boxset blends the tactile charm of camera lenses with the character of oxidized bronze finishing, capturing time with nostalgic precision. Featuring a fish-eye sapphire lens, rotating bezel, automatic movement, and bronze-toned case, this edition reimagines TACS’s iconic AVL II in a new light. To elevate collectability, each set is paired with a handmade Robotoy—individually numbered to match the watch. With only 150 sets worldwide, every detail—from the dual-strap setup to the wooden presentation box—has been designed for collectors, creatives, and camera lovers alike.

watches.name: AVL II – the Bokeh
watches.description: Inspired by the soft blur of bokeh, AVL II Bokeh is a 47mm sapphire crystal automatic timepiece, limited to 500 pieces, built to frame time with elegance. Limited Edition 500pcs Package price with extra leather strap The AVL II – Bokeh Edition is a celebration of TACS’ decade-long pursuit of design, photography, and time. Inspired by bokeh — the poetic blur of lights in photography — this flagship timepiece captures that dreamy depth in a 47mm camera-lens–inspired case. A domed fisheye sapphire crystal magnifies the intricate dial, while the rotating bezel mimics the tactile focus ring of an analog camera. The brushed steel finish and skeleton open-heart movement are pure mechanical art, powered by a reliable Japanese Miyota 82S0 automatic movement with 42-hour power reserve. Limited to 500 numbered pieces , each Bokeh Edition is assembled in Japan, engraved with its own serial number, and built for creators who appreciate depth — in both light and time.

watches.name: AVL II – Rubber
watches.description: A watch with a heart that captures the soul of photography A fresh take on the iconic AVL II – now with vibrant rubber straps and a complimentary stainless steel band. Built for action, styled for expression. Engineered for Movement. Styled for You. The AVL II – Rubber is your perfect daily companion, whether you’re chasing golden hour light through the lens or just racing for the train. Inspired by vintage cameras but built for a modern lifestyle, this version of AVL II reinvents itself with a dynamic rubber strap upgrade – now available in 5 bold colors to match your pace and personality. More than just a style switch, this set comes with a free stainless steel strap , letting you move seamlessly from sweat to suit. Featuring a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal, 10ATM water resistance, and Super-LumiNova hands and dial, it’s made for urban explorers and creative souls who demand both functionality and flair . Whether you’re navigating daily commutes, chasing golden light for street photography, or winding down in a café after a long shoot, the AVL II Rubber moves with you — without skipping a beat. It’s not just a watch that adapts to your lifestyle. It’s a style chameleon with substance: durable enough for rainy city days, expressive enough to match your mood, and versatile enough to carry you from Monday to midnight. With its camera-inspired design DNA and interchangeable rubber and steel strap combo, the AVL II Rubber is built for creators, commuters, and everyone in between. From boardroom to boardwalk, it’s your new default wrist gear. Whether you go bold in red, cool in navy, or low-key in black, the AVL II – Rubber is your go-to for every scene, every mood, every day.

watches.name: AVL II – Boxset
watches.description: A collector’s dream in one box. The AVL II Boxset includes a camera-inspired automatic watch, both leather and metal straps, a strap tool, warranty card, and a premium wooden box. Time, redefined. Step into the world of mechanical elegance and camera-inspired craftsmanship with the AVL II – Boxset — a collector’s edition that celebrates the fusion of horology and photography. Encased in a sleek, handcrafted long wooden box, this limited set brings together the iconic AVL II automatic watch with a full suite of accessories for the modern-day enthusiast. Inspired by the design of vintage single-lens cameras, the AVL II’s square case and rotating bezel mimic the tactile satisfaction of focusing a manual lens. At its heart beats a robust Japanese automatic movement, visible through its open-heart dial and framed by a fisheye-style sapphire crystal — offering a deep view into the watch’s mechanical soul. This long box set includes: A full stainless steel bracelet for timeless urban utility A premium leather strap for casual everyday elegance A professional-grade adjustment tool for easy resizing An official warranty card Whether you’re a photography lover, a mechanical purist, or a collector searching for meaning in motion, this set is designed to adapt, impress, and elevate your wrist game. Learn more about sapphire crystal watch glass and how it compares to mineral. Explore the ATL Rollei or discover the ultra-light ATL Lite set.

specsRaw.Color: Vintage Brown -AZ, Rustic Brown -BZ, Dark Black -CZ, Two Tone -FZ, Golden Hour -GZ

watches.name: AVL II
watches.description: A watch with a heart that captures the soul of photography – A 47mm automatic masterpiece with fisheye sapphire crystal, rotating bezel, and open-heart dial. AVL II captures time like a lens captures light. AVL II – The Ultimate 47mm Automatic Masterpiece with Fisheye Lens | TACS AVL II stands as the ultimate expression of the TACS design philosophy: minimal form, rich concept, and deep inspiration drawn from analog photography. Inspired by the architecture of a vintage camera lens, the AVL II reimagines what a timepiece can be—not just an object that tells time, but a mechanical sculpture that frames it. Its 47mm case mirrors the form of a manual single-lens reflex camera. The rotating bezel mimics a focus ring, giving you the tactile satisfaction of adjusting your watch like you would fine-tune your lens. At the heart of the dial, a fisheye sapphire crystal magnifies the open-heart Japanese movement, inviting you to observe the movement’s rhythm like watching light pass through glass. The beauty of AVL II isn’t just visual—it’s experiential. Whether you’re turning the bezel, catching light on the curved dome, or watching the balance wheel oscillate, this watch draws you into the moment. The watch is assembled in Japan, featuring a Miyota 82S0 automatic movement with 42 hours of power reserve. It’s a timepiece made for creators, thinkers, and those who see the world through a more intentional lens. Unlike traditional watches, the AVL II doesn’t rush. It celebrates details—layered mechanics, bold proportions, and perfect symmetry. From its sapphire crystal to its screw-down crown and 10 ATM water resistance, AVL II is made to be worn boldly and lived with daily. Whether you wear it with a leather strap for a vintage aesthetic, or with a stainless steel bracelet for a more industrial feel, AVL II adapts to your personal style. It isn’t just a product—it’s a philosophy wrapped around your wrist. Learn more about the Miyota 82S0 movement Looking for something more compact? Explore our ATL Rollei — a lightweight lens-inspired design perfect for daily wear.

specsRaw.Color: Vintage Brown -A, Rustic Brown -B, Dark Leather -C, Dark Metal -D, Silver Metal -E, Telephoto Two Tone -F, Golden Hour - G, Telephoto Leather -H, Golden Leather -I

watches.name: ICICLE
watches.description: Moment of Glowing Treasure – A poetic expression of time, ICICLE captures the sparkle of spring light through a bubble-kissed dome glass—delivering elegance in motion. ICICLE is a minimalist women’s watch that captures the delicate beauty of spring light. Its signature bubble-dome crystal mimics the way morning dew glistens—curved, soft, and reflective. Beneath this unique lens lies a sand-finished silver dial, simple and open, echoing the peaceful stillness of nature. The case is carefully sized at 33mm, paired with pastel-toned genuine leather straps, making it effortless to wear and beautifully refined. A Miyota quartz movement keeps time quietly in the background, while the curved 4 o’clock crown and engraved details add subtle touches of charm. More than a watch, ICICLE is a poetic reminder to embrace softness, light, and the quiet rhythm of passing time.

specsRaw.Color: Refreshing Orange -A, Frosty White -B, Vanilla White -C, Matcha Green -D, Sakura Pink -E

watches.name: Time Glass
watches.description: Between Past and Future – A crownless, hourglass-inspired watch with a funnel dial and curved hands—Time Glass is a poetic symbol of time flowing through the present moment. Time Glass captures the poetic rhythm of time itself. Inspired by the form and meaning of the hourglass, this crownless timepiece symbolizes the flow between past, present, and future. Its curved funnel dial and parabolic hands echo the shape of falling sand, creating a visual illusion of motion. The crownless design—adjusted via a single push button on the caseback—keeps the side silhouette clean, minimalist, and symbolic. Whether in silver or black, Time Glass is a meditative reminder to live in the now.

watches.name: PLP 2
watches.description: The second-generation PLP with a bold single-disk hour display, upgraded colors, and minimalist form—designed for creative minds. A bold evolution of the original PLP, the PLP2 redefines time through a single rotating disk that marks the hours in an abstract yet intuitive way. Featuring a minimalist dial with a centered “hour zone,” this design challenges conventions while remaining effortlessly wearable. The second generation of PLP introduces a vibrant color palette and refined dial construction, celebrating clarity, focus, and the art of simplicity. Crafted with a sleek stainless steel case and paired with a supple leather strap, PLP2 embodies modern sophistication for those who seek meaning in every detail. Whether you’re a design lover or a collector of the unconventional, this timepiece adds a subtle twist to daily life.

watches.name: Day & Night – Luminous
watches.description: A 24-hour single-hand luminous watch with poetic minimalism. Day and Night – Luminous reminds you to live slowly, even after sunset. Crafted for those who chase meaning in every moment, the Day & Night – Luminous is a poetic reimagination of time itself. Built on a Ronda 24-hour Swiss movement , this unique one-hand watch redefines your daily rhythm by slowing it down—literally. The hour hand completes a full rotation every 24 hours, allowing you to truly feel time rather than rush through it. The dial is split into two matte halves representing day and night, while the dot on the hand marks the sun’s path from noon to midnight. What makes this version special is the Super-LumiNova luminous feature , which softly glows in the dark. The dot and circular indicators light up like celestial bodies, offering a gentle reminder to find balance—even in the dark.

watches.name: Day & Night
watches.description: A 24-hour single-hand watch that captures the quiet beauty of day and night — and the power of slowing down. Day & Night isn’t just a watch — it’s a gentle reminder to slow down. With only one hand circling the dial every 24 hours, time flows at half the usual pace. The watch features a symbolic sun and moon graphic, marking noon and midnight with minimal yet poetic visual cues. Whether you’re chasing daylight or embracing dusk, this timepiece reflects life’s dualities and invites you to live at your own rhythm. Crafted with a slim 316L stainless steel case and Swiss Ronda 505.24H movement, the Day & Night redefines how time should be read — slowly, with intention. A matte dual-texture dial, sun-moon markers, and ultra-thin Italian vegetable-tanned leather straps complete the look.

specsRaw.Color: Sunny Day -A, Dark Night -B, Night Blue -C, Sunset Rose Gold -E

watches.name: Mirror
watches.description: A reflection of you – A minimal yet imaginative timepiece with a mirror dial that reflects your world and reveals hidden visual surprises. Reflective simplicity meets optical illusion. The TACS Mirror transforms the concept of reflection into wearable design. Its highly polished mirror dial is not only functional but poetic—changing with every angle, object, and ray of light it captures. At first glance, it appears minimal, yet hidden details reveal more: a 3D index at 3 o’clock which aligns with its mirror reflection to form a full number “3”, a wordmark engraved at 9 o’clock, and a mirrored “3” subtly marked on the case back. The second hand moves seamlessly across a dial gap—proving that design and mechanics can coexist without compromise. Paired with Italian leather straps in dual-toned combinations, the Mirror isn’t just a timepiece. It’s a statement—quiet yet bold, real yet surreal.

watches.name: PLP
watches.description: A minimalist timepiece inspired by geometry — no second hand, just a moving sculpture of “Point, Line, Plane” in motion. The PLP (Point, Line, Plane) reimagines timekeeping through the lens of geometry. Instead of a traditional hour hand, it features a rhombus-shaped graphic labeled “HOUR” and a linear minute hand. The interaction between the two creates constantly shifting visual shapes — a dynamic expression of dimension and movement. Crafted with a solid stainless steel case and engraved with “Point Line Plane” at the 9 o’clock position, this minimalist watch reflects Bauhaus simplicity while pushing boundaries. The clean face — with no second hand — invites calm and clarity. Paired with a premium Italian leather strap that slides beneath the sleek case body, the PLP is as much a tactile experience as it is visual. More than a watch, PLP is a philosophy: a graphic study of time through point, line, and plane.

watches.name: Vintage Lens
watches.description: Retro style, vintage lens – Inspired by vintage camera lenses, this bold timepiece pairs industrial metal detailing with nostalgic warmth — a modern classic with retro soul. A timepiece where vintage aesthetics meet mechanical strength — the Vintage Lens captures the nostalgic charm of old-school camera gear with a powerful design language. The bezel mimics a wide-angle lens, complete with precise concentric circles that echo shutter blades, bringing photography’s essence to your wrist. The brushed metal case, heavy-duty crown, and solid buckle reflect industrial confidence, while a thick, genuine leather strap anchors the watch with style and comfort. A side engraving of a treasure mark adds a secret vintage code, and the see-through case back showcases the detailed rotor mechanism. Every angle reflects the passion of analogue creation. If you miss the tactile era of design — this is your modern gateway.

watches.name: S&P (Salt & Pepper)
watches.description: Salt & Pepper: a minimalist pair watch set with dot indices and warm textures, symbolizing lifelong companionship. S&P — short for Salt & Pepper — reimagines timeless togetherness with minimalist expression. Inspired by the inseparable duo of seasoning staples, this pair of timepieces represents balance, memory, and companionship . With engraved dot indices that subtly shape an “S” or “P”, each dial speaks to the individuality of the pair, while remaining elegantly symmetrical when viewed as a set. The gently curved dial offers softness in form, while the genuine leather strap and wooden-feel case flank whisper a sense of peace and comfort. Together, they’re not just watches — they are a poetic metaphor of harmony, designed to be worn together, lived together .

specsRaw.Salt & Pepper: a minimalist pair watch set with dot indices and warm textures, symbolizing lifelong companionship.

watches.name: Daily Icon
watches.description: A minimalist watch embossed with lifestyle icons — inspired by modern life, created to mark your moments. In a world filled with routines, Daily Icon turns everyday moments into poetic time. Inspired by the universal signs we interact with—power buttons, shopping carts, airplanes, utensils—TACS transforms these symbols into subtle, embossed icons on a watch dial, turning your wrist into a visual map of modern living. Each symbol carries a quiet story—moments of rest, work, travel, recharge. The layout is intentionally non-linear, echoing the unpredictable yet beautiful rhythm of our lives. With a simple circular case, minimal bezel, and a neatly integrated date window, this watch feels both modern and reflective. Whether you’re in a café, commuting, or planning your next trip, Daily Icon reminds you: your lifestyle is your time. Available in sleek steel or matte black, it’s perfect for smart-casual outfits, workdays, and creative days off.

specsRaw.You see them every day: a shopping cart, a calendar, a phone icon. We live through these signs, so why not wear them?

watches.name: Nature S
watches.description: A petite watch designed for women, combining light wood grain with a soft genuine leather strap. Simple, cozy, and naturally elegant. Reconnect with the natural world through simplicity and comfort. Nature S is a petite and lightweight timepiece crafted with a wood grain case and soft genuine leather strap. Designed for women who appreciate subtle elegance, this model features an earthy palette, paired with a minimalist dial marked by delicate indexes. The military-style band design not only adds character but also ensures an ultra-comfortable fit for everyday wear. Whether you’re heading outdoors or enjoying a calm moment indoors, Nature S brings nature’s warmth and authenticity to your wrist.

watches.name: Nature L
watches.description: A lightweight watch crafted with wood grain and leather, designed to reconnect you with nature through warmth, texture, and thoughtful simplicity. As time passes, we begin to rediscover something long overlooked — the quiet strength of nature. Nature L is a watch that reflects this rediscovery. From the grain-textured case to the genuine leather dial, every surface of this timepiece speaks softly, like a walk in the woods or a breath of mountain air. The case is crafted using lightweight wood-grain material, giving the watch a natural texture and effortless comfort. Instead of metal rigidity, you feel warmth. The dial, wrapped in aged leather, bears markings like those found on well-used hiking gear — weathered, familiar, and honest. The military-inspired leather strap adds rugged elegance, perfect for explorers at heart. With two colorways — raw wood brown and matte black — Nature L balances primitive charm with modern simplicity. Whether you wear it in the city or out on a trail, this is a watch that lets your wrist breathe.

watches.name: Kraft
watches.description: A poetic tribute to kraft paper and simplicity — featuring a curved dial with “FRAGILE” box icons and raw textures that celebrate the art of understatement. Inspired by the everyday materials that wrap, protect, and express, the Kraft watch transforms humble kraft paper into a refined minimalist statement. With a dial made to resemble natural packaging textures — either traditional earthy brown or understated grey — this timepiece pays tribute to simplicity and tactile authenticity. Instead of numerals or markers, the dial features familiar carton box symbols like “FRAGILE” and “Handle with Care,” playfully printed at the 9 o’clock position. This visual language evokes a message: time is delicate, moments are precious — treat them with care. The lugs and case are intentionally asymmetrical, further amplifying the free-spirited, boundaryless philosophy behind the design. Viewed from the side, the convex dial subtly curves upward, adding a quiet sense of depth and dimension.

watches.name: World Kraft M
watches.description: Dual time-zone watch with embossed kraft-paper dial and “FRAGILE” detailing — poetic, minimal, and ready for travel. World Kraft-M reimagines travel timekeeping through the lens of tactile simplicity. This dual time-zone watch features an embossed kraft paper dial with minimalist “FRAGILE” graphics — a symbolic reminder of the emotional weight behind journeys, memories, and moments shared between two places. Each sub-dial is marked with raised letters: “H” for Home, “A” for Away, and “S” for Second, delivering a clever, discreet indication of time zones. The asymmetrical dual crown design — slanted at 2 and 8 o’clock — adds a distinctive visual character, while the skeletonized case construction reduces weight and brings a sense of openness to the design. Available in two earthy tones — original kraft brown and textured white — both options contrast beautifully with the black case and bracelet. From subtle functionality to poetic visual cues, World Kraft-M is crafted for the traveler with quiet depth.

watches.name: Mini Kraft M
watches.description: A petite, playful timepiece with kraft-inspired dials and “FRAGILE” graphics — simple, light, and smart casual ready. Mini Kraft-M is a playful nod to the everyday — a miniature watch inspired by the unassuming beauty of kraft paper. Its design brings together the raw, organic feeling of stationery materials with TACS’s signature design language: simple, natural, and quietly expressive. The dial features lightly embossed markers, with bold, printed symbols like “FRAGILE” and “DON’T BREAK IT” that mimic shipping labels. These visual cues inject a subtle layer of humor and conceptual storytelling into the piece, reminding us that time — like a package — is precious. The ultra-slim mesh band wraps elegantly around the wrist, making it ideal for smaller wrists or those who favor lightweight accessories. With three dial finishes — deep black, original kraft brown, and soft textured white — the Mini Kraft-M series adapts to every casual mood with effortless grace.

watches.name: LP-M
watches.description: In tune with the times – A nostalgic tribute to vinyl, the LP-M combines wood grain, record-inspired dial texture, and modern steel craftsmanship in one timeless watch. LP-M is a tribute to the Long Playing Record that was popular from the 1950s until the 1980s. The watch face has that classic vinyl-look to it with a ring of wood around it to represent what the LP player would have been made of. The straps of LP-M are made of metal for added strength and quality. With the resurgence in trends and pop culture from this period, we felt it was only fitting to create a timepiece that paid proper homage to the iconic LP. Step into the rhythm of time with the LP-M , a wristwatch inspired by the timeless beauty of Long Playing records. With design cues echoing vinyl grooves, a reflective silver-tone rim, and a wood grain inlay that mimics classic turntables, this piece pays tribute to the golden age of music. From the 1950s to the 1980s, LPs captured the soul of generations—and now, LP-M captures it on your wrist. Crafted in stainless steel or full black finishes , the case design is deliberately minimalist, enhancing the bold graphic of the dial. The plastic dial features engraved concentric rings, replicating the texture of a record disc, while the wood-inspired ring adds vintage warmth. Whether you’re a collector, a music lover, or simply someone with refined taste, LP-M is a wearable memory that plays with time.

watches.name: Pixel
watches.description: A multi-layered 3D watch design inspired by digital pixels, encouraging you to pause and notice every moment. Pixel is not just a watch — it’s a reminder to slow down and magnify the moment. Inspired by the building blocks of digital imagery, Pixel takes the humble square — the pixel — and turns it into a 3D design statement. The dial, bezel, and even the side of the case are layered with a cascade of stepped cube textures, evoking the sense of digital pixels being “zoomed in” and frozen in time. The deeper you look, the more you discover. Each block is sculpted at varying heights, forming a geometric landscape that captures light, shadow, and curiosity. This architectural abstraction extends from the dial across the case edge, seamlessly blending 2D digital language with tangible craftsmanship. Whether in full matte black, earthy brown, or brushed grey, Pixel challenges how we perceive time — not as something fleeting, but as a grid of precious seconds waiting to be noticed.

specsRaw.Color: Matte Black -A, Dark Brown -B, Dark Camel -C
specsRaw.The idea is simple: the closer you look, the more you see. Pixel is a tribute to that idea — turning the basic building blocks of digital life into tactile, wearable art.

watches.name: Little Drop
watches.description: A petite and poetic watch design inspired by ripples of water, blending elegance and minimalism. A delicate interpretation of simplicity, the Little Drop features a domed crystal mimicking the rippling surface of water. With no indices and only three sleek hands, the watch embodies a clean and calming aesthetic. The unique bubbly-shaped bezel adds a soft contour to the petite case, while the layered glass construction offers a soft refractive effect—like capturing a droplet in motion.

specsRaw.Color: Black -A, TAN -D, Rose Pink -E, Sky Blue -F, Milk White -G

watches.name: Double Channel
watches.description: A dual-time stainless steel watch with audio-inspired display and independent top & bottom crowns. Double Channel is a bold reinterpretation of dual-time functionality through a visual language inspired by vintage audio equipment. Its elongated rectangular dial mimics an audio frequency display, complete with two vertical tracks that show “Home” and “Away” time zones using independent disc hands. The design is elevated by a three-dimensional rotating seconds disc — a polished round indicator reminiscent of an analog tuner knob — adding both visual rhythm and precision. The irregular hour markers and layered dial structure enhance its sense of depth and motion. The watch is completed with T-shaped crowns on the top and bottom of the case, allowing separate adjustment of each time zone. Their unique placement also reinforces the feeling of symmetry and function — like fine-tuning frequencies on a radio. Crafted entirely in brushed stainless steel with either deep black or rose gold finishes, Double Channel is a balance of old and new: retro soul, modern edge. Designed to help you stay connected across time zones — and in tune with yourself.

watches.name: Mask Player M
watches.description: A minimalist stainless steel watch that masks half the dial — symbolizing balance and crafted with 3 polishing styles. Mask Player-M reimagines the iconic Mask Player with a full stainless steel construction and a more sculpted visual language. The watch dial is uniquely masked across its top half, symbolizing the duality and balance between work and life — a subtle metaphor for modern living. Unlike the original Mask Player, the crown of the M version is moved to the six o’clock position, reinforcing the idea of visual balance and symmetry. The stainless steel bracelet and case are unified in color and finish, delivering a clean, fluid aesthetic from lug to clasp. To enhance depth and refinement, three different polishing methods are applied across the dial, case, and surface, giving the watch a sophisticated sense of dimension. From top view to side profile, the watch embodies architectural simplicity, with a touch of abstract philosophy. Available in matte black and warm bronze finishes, Mask Player-M is minimal, meaningful, and mechanical — a statement in steel.

watches.name: Channel Box
watches.description: A bold, retro-style watch inspired by vintage sound systems. Rotating disc display meets etched audio-inspired detail. Channel Box channels the spirit of retro sound systems into a timepiece — bold, boxy, and built with details that echo vintage radio design. Its square case and recessed aluminum face recall old-school stereo equipment, while a rotating disc replaces traditional hands to show the time. On the dial, finely etched lines simulate speaker grills, and the layered frame adds a sculptural edge. The crown is positioned traditionally, like a volume knob on the side. Functional markers for hours, minutes, and seconds are aligned on the left, emphasizing its dashboard-like layout. With bold colorways — ice white with aqua, black and ivory, and gold with brown — Channel Box is an expressive accessory that feels both nostalgic and forward-thinking. This is not just a watch. It’s your personal frequency.

specsRaw.Color: Classic White -A, Classic Black -B, Vintage Bronze -C

watches.name: TFO-D
watches.description: A futuristic disc-watch design with floating hour and minute indicators, enhanced by 3D optical depth and cow leather comfort. TFO-D redefines how we read time. Instead of traditional watch hands, this model features two floating discs — one for hours, one for minutes — that rotate with mesmerizing precision. The result is a clean, futuristic dial that feels like it’s suspended under glass, offering a subtle three-dimensional depth. Each turn of the discs reflects ambient light, creating dynamic shadows and highlights that shift with every movement of your wrist. Minimalist markers and color accents make time both readable and visually compelling. The watch is paired with a fine cow leather strap, giving it a natural softness that contrasts perfectly with the sci-fi geometry of the dial. Available in three variations — white/pink, gray/tan, and military green/orange — TFO-D is built for curious minds and confident minimalists alike.

specsRaw.Color: Space White -A, Cosmic Grey -B, Galaxy Green -C

watches.name: Channel Cute
watches.description: A vintage radio–inspired mini watch with dual rotating discs and a bold, playful dial. Designed for everyday charm. Channel Cute is inspired by the charm of small vintage radios — compact, colorful, and filled with character. The watch’s unique rectangular case resembles a retro tabletop radio, complete with etched aluminum plating and a bold color dial. Two rotating discs take the place of traditional hands, echoing old-school frequency dials. The crown at the 12 o’clock position mimics a classic radio tuner, adding a nostalgic yet playful touch. It’s a clever fusion of sound and time — made visible. Offered in three expressive colorways — violet, turquoise, and rose gold — Channel Cute brings a sense of personality and modernity to a timeless silhouette. Whether worn as a quirky accent or a design-forward fashion piece, this is a watch that makes a statement. Retro, playful, and unmistakably cute — tune into your own time.

specsRaw.Color: Majestic Magenta -A, Boutique Brown -B, Classic White -C

watches.name: T-Cam
watches.description: A digital camera–inspired square watch with layered bezel, lens dial, and anti-slip silicone strap. T-Cam captures the silhouette of a digital camera and transforms it into a wristwatch — clean, layered, and modern. Its square bezel features inward-sloping edges and layered depth, resembling the lens and body of a compact camera. Viewed from the side, the case forms a unique trapezoidal shape, further enhancing the geometric identity. Each corner is subtly refined to echo the mechanical feel of a well-designed digital camera. The watch dial showcases concentric rings like a lens, with the word “ELEVEN” placed subtly near the top, reinforcing the idea of framing time. The silicone strap is inspired by camera grip textures, not only visually aligned with the overall concept but also engineered with anti-slip function for active daily use. Offered in three versions — silver ring, rose gold ring, and champagne gold ring — T-Cam balances minimalist camera aesthetics with tactile depth. This is not just a watch; it’s a tribute to visual culture.

watches.name: TFO
watches.description: A bowl-shaped minimalist watch with quadrant index detail. Sculptural in form, smooth in motion. TFO, short for “Time Flows On,” captures the essence of modern minimalism through perfect balance and motion. Its unique bowl-shaped dial and raised outer ring create a sense of quiet depth, inviting your attention inward. The dial design focuses on one quadrant, where a clean set of index markings suggests time without dominating the visual field. Paired with clean lines and uninterrupted finishes, TFO is not only minimal — it’s sculptural. With a 42mm stainless steel case, the watch feels substantial yet refined. The palette offers expressive choices: full black, bold violet, soft grey, and crisp ivory — all paired with monochromatic leather straps. Whether you wear it as a statement or a subtle complement, TFO reflects a mindset: calm, deliberate, and always moving forward.

specsRaw.Color: Midnight Black -A, Planetary Purple -B, Saucer Grey -C, Starlight Cream -D

watches.name: Twenty 4
watches.description: A minimalist watch with a 24-hour subdial and clean single-hand layout. Quiet design for focused living. Twenty-4 is a minimalist timepiece designed to bring clarity and focus to your daily rhythm. Its signature 24-hour subdial, placed subtly at 6 o’clock, helps visualize the full day at a glance. The main dial is kept clean and pure, with a single hour hand floating across a matte finish face — keeping your mind clear and your time intentional. With a compact 38mm stainless steel case and ultra-clean dial layout, Twenty-4 balances visual calm with functional depth. Each model comes with a different color palette — from full black, warm neutrals to soft metallics — offering timelessness in every tone. Designed for those who embrace calm, precision, and focus, Twenty-4 reminds us that time doesn’t need to shout to be felt.

specsRaw.Color: Midnight Black -A, Tan Brown -B, Cream White -C

watches.name: Color Lens
watches.description: A camera lens–inspired sports watch with colorful aluminum rings, rubber strap, and 50M water resistance. Color Lens brings a bold, high-contrast twist to TACS’ signature Lens series. Inspired by camera lenses and engineered for dynamic lifestyles, this model combines professional detailing with everyday ruggedness. The dial mimics the concentric grooves of a camera aperture, while the aluminum color ring surrounding it references precision aperture markings. Paired with a robust case and notched bezel, it echoes the tactile feedback of adjusting a real lens. This model upgrades practicality with a soft rubber strap, 50M water resistance, and clear numerical indexes around the dial’s perimeter. Available in three color styles — white (A), army green (B), and orange (C) — each version balances bold expression with functional resilience. Whether you’re in the city or outdoors, Color Lens gives you a sharp focus on time — and style.

specsRaw.Color: Flash White -A, Camo Green -B, Slate Orange -C

watches.name: Swing
watches.description: Have some fun, have a swing. A suspended-case watch with a floating dial and day-date function. Built for movement, designed for rhythm. Swing is a kinetic expression of time — balancing motion and architecture in a frame-like construction. Its open-lug rectangular case suspends the circular dial in mid-air, creating a sense of floating space. The dial features layered textures, radial markings, and a semi-transparent day-date window, all aligned to evoke movement and clarity. What sets Swing apart is its unique suspended lug design — the strap appears to “swing” freely from the case, emphasizing lightness and fluidity. With color-accented second hands and alternating finishes, each variant offers its own visual rhythm. Whether you choose the khaki/silver (A), bronze/black with neon accents (B), or full matte black (C), Swing brings a contemporary voice to wearable mechanics. It’s not just a watch — it’s structure in motion.

watches.name: Screen Multi
watches.description: A dual-dial quartz watch inspired by mixing boards and control panels. Structural, multi-functional, and distinctly bold. Screen Multi takes the structural foundation of the Screen series and amplifies its complexity — adding twin subdials for day and date, while preserving the bold rectangular form. Inspired by mixing consoles and architectural schematics, the dial combines vertical hour markings with two cogwheel-style subdials. The left subdial rotates through days of the week, while the right shows the date in circular motion. This hybrid display system balances visual structure with real-world function. The stainless steel case features a mirror-polished finish with oversized screw accents, evoking industrial materials and raw utility. Paired with a wide strap and beveled crystal, Screen Multi wears like a wrist sculpture — solid, graphic, and precise. Whether you choose the stealth-like gunmetal model or the high-contrast gold edition, Screen Multi is built for those who appreciate mechanical design, but want it wearable.

watches.name: Screen Basic
watches.description: A rectangular quartz watch inspired by analog control panels. Bold, balanced, and industrially minimal. Screen Basic reimagines time with an architectural approach — blending symmetry, structure, and industrial detailing into a bold wrist statement. The rectangular dial features raised, grid-like time markings paired with vertical bar indicators, reminiscent of analog sound mixers or control panels. Each index is engraved with both numerals and text, giving the watch a layered, machine-like clarity. Paired with a custom-cut mineral crystal and polished steel case, the result is an object that feels both modern and mechanical. A fabric-textured leather strap with industrial screw accents anchors the design — echoing the raw materiality of concrete, steel, and screen interfaces. Whether you appreciate raw design aesthetics or simply seek a timepiece with presence and individuality, Screen Basic frames time in a way that feels both functional and sculptural.

watches.name: Drop-D
watches.description: A drop of uniqueness – A bold, disc-based time display with a 3D ripple illusion, housed in full leather for unmatched comfort and modern minimalism. Drop-D is the bold evolution of the Drop series — a striking reinterpretation of time through depth, movement, and visual purity. Built around an avant-garde concept, this timepiece removes traditional hour markers and instead uses rotating discs layered beneath a gradient-colored mineral glass dome, delivering a mesmerizing 3-dimensional illusion. Its sculptural round case and full soft leather casing make it as comfortable as it is captivating. From white serenity to monochrome modernity, Drop-D makes an artistic statement on your wrist, inviting you to see time through ripples, not ticks.

watches.name: Dice
watches.description: A playful quartz watch with rotating disc display and bold colors. Minimalist and vibrant in one square frame. Dice is a bold reinterpretation of time — turning the traditional watch face into a playful, color-coded graphic display. Designed with concentric disc layers and a square case, it invites users to read time through contrast, not convention. Each ring on the dial indicates a unit of time: outer for hours, inner for minutes — with subtle dots and pointer lines guiding your eye. Minimal markers replace numerals, and the mirrored mineral crystal amplifies both depth and movement. Inspired by arcade aesthetics and retro colorways, Dice comes in a series of vibrant combinations — from crisp monochrome to yellow-green, deep red, and bright violet. The slim rectangular build and leather strap make it ideal for small wrists or those who prefer a lighter, artistic statement. More than a timepiece, Dice is a wearable rhythm — a design that doesn’t just tell time, but transforms it.

watches.name: Drop
watches.description: A ripple-inspired quartz watch with a bowl-shaped dial and domed crystal. Clean, reflective, and quietly expressive. Drop is a poetic take on time — inspired by the moment a water droplet hits a calm surface. The watch translates that quiet ripple into a minimalist design, with a bowl-shaped dial that draws light into its center like a still pond. Crafted with a domed mineral crystal and a unique concave dial surface, Drop creates depth without distraction. The absence of numerals enhances the fluid aesthetic, allowing light and shadow to shape the way time is seen. Each model offers a different interpretation of calm: from milky white (A), translucent grey (B), deep bronze with a pop of orange (C), to a soft grey matched with white leather (D). With a 316L stainless steel case, Japanese quartz movement, and a clean leather strap, Drop balances form and function with quiet confidence. Wearing Drop is like carrying a moment of stillness — a visual pause, beautifully designed for everyday life.

watches.name: Soap
watches.description: A minimalist quartz watch with a rounded square case and floating circular dial. Calm geometry, worn with ease. Soap is a minimalist quartz watch that plays with geometry — combining a perfectly round dial within a softly rounded square case. Inspired by the calming, balanced form of a bar of soap, this timepiece focuses on proportion, clarity, and light reflection. The brushed silver dial glows subtly under changing angles, while the absence of numerals enhances its clean, visual symmetry. The watch case blends curved metal corners with a floating round face, creating a layered sense of space. Simple markers and pencil-style hands complete the look, keeping time in the quietest way possible. Powered by a Japanese quartz movement and paired with a black leather strap, Soap is designed for those who prefer subtle confidence over attention-seeking flash. It’s architecture and emotion, rendered in a single, wearable form.

watches.name: Mask Player
watches.description: A cassette-inspired watch with rotating disc display. Bold, rhythmic, and unmistakably unique. Mask Player is a creative reinterpretation of how we read time — turning a watch into an abstract cassette player. Instead of traditional hands, three rotating discs indicate the hours, minutes, and seconds. The right half of the dial is masked, revealing only a sector where time is “played.” Each movement mimics the loop of a cassette tape, reminding us that time is always spinning forward. The unique dial layout is enclosed in a brushed 316L stainless steel case, offering both durability and futuristic appeal. Paired with a genuine leather strap and powered by a reliable Japanese quartz movement, Mask Player balances function with visual rhythm. With its asymmetric display and balanced geometry, this timepiece challenges the ordinary and invites wearers to “listen” to time in a new way. Whether you’re nostalgic for analog or simply drawn to unconventional design, Mask Player is made for those who move to their own beat.

watches.name: Soap-M
watches.description: A minimalist quartz watch inspired by the soft, clean form of soap. Smooth, subtle, and intuitively elegant. Soap-M draws inspiration from the everyday shape of a bar of soap — soft, clean, and universally familiar. This minimalist quartz watch transforms simplicity into elegance, echoing TACS’ belief in finding beauty through form and clarity. Its rounded square case mimics the gentle curves of soap, while the polished finish reflects natural light for a subtle, almost fluid-like effect. The translucent dial adds depth without distraction, encouraging a more intuitive reading of time. Sized for comfort and visual balance, the Soap-M case feels organic on the wrist. The minimalist dial, free of numerals, keeps the focus on proportion, shape, and material — nothing more, nothing less. Whether you’re dressing with ease or looking for something quietly distinctive, Soap-M fits effortlessly into any moment. It’s the kind of watch that doesn’t ask for attention — but earns it over time.

watches.name: Lens-M
watches.description: A minimalist quartz watch inspired by vintage camera lenses. Layered, focused, and built for everyday wear. Lens-M is a minimalist quartz watch inspired by the beauty of vintage camera lenses. Its multi-layered dial mimics the concentric rings of a lens, drawing the eye into its center — just like a camera focusing on a subject. The domed crystal evokes the curved surface of glass optics, while subtle markings and radial textures reflect photographic details. Despite its inspiration, Lens-M is not loud. It’s quiet, refined, and meant to be worn. The 41.5mm case fits comfortably on the wrist, with a slim profile and clean edges that echo the Bauhaus-like restraint of both classic cameras and modern watches. The Lens-M isn’t made just for photographers — it’s for anyone who sees beauty in framing moments. With a reliable Japanese quartz movement and timeless silhouette, this is a timepiece designed to bring clarity and depth to your everyday routine. Whether you’re shooting photos, making memories, or simply pausing to take in your surroundings, Lens-M reminds you to stay focused.

Its domed crystal and concentric dial design recreate the visual illusion of ripples expanding outward — a poetic take on time in motion. Minimalist in function and elegant in presence, this quartz timepiece reflects the TACS philosophy of finding inspiration in everyday simplicity. Drop-M invites you to pause, reflect, and appreciate each passing second.
